title: Optimal Time Complexity Algorithms for Computing General Random Walk Graph Kernels on Sparse Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2410.10368v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present the first linear time complexity randomized algorithms for unbiased approximation of the celebrated family of general random walk kernels (RWKs) for sparse graphs. This includes both labelled and unlabelled instances. The previous fastest methods for general RWKs were of cubic time complexity and not applicable to labelled graphs. Our method samples dependent random walks to compute novel graph embeddings in $\mathbb{R}^d$ whose dot product is equal to the true RWK in expectation. It does so without instantiating the direct product graph in memory, meaning we can scale to massive datasets that cannot be stored on a single machine. We derive exponential concentration bounds to prove that our estimator is sharp, and show that the ability to approximate general RWKs (rather than just special cases) unlocks efficient implicit graph kernel learning. translated_title: 稀疏图上计算一般随机游走图核的最优时间复杂度算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2410.10368v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们首次提出了用于稀疏图上无偏近似著名的一般随机游走核（RWKs）家族的线性时间复杂度随机算法。这包括有标签和无标签的实例。此前，一般RWKs的最快方法具有三次时间复杂度，且不适用于有标签图。我们的方法通过采样依赖的随机游走来计算新颖的图嵌入，该嵌入位于$\mathbb{R}^d$中，其点积在期望上等于真实的RWK。它无需在内存中实例化直接乘积图，因此可以扩展到无法存储在单台机器上的大规模数据集。我们推导了指数浓度界限来证明我们的估计器是尖锐的，并展示了近似一般RWKs（而不仅仅是特殊情形）的能力解锁了高效的隐式图核学习。我们的方法在效率上比其对应方法快高达$\mathbf{27\times}$。
tldr: 我们提出了首个线性时间复杂度的随机算法，用于稀疏图上一般随机游走核的无偏近似，通过采样依赖随机游走生成嵌入，无需直接乘积图，显著提升效率并支持大规模数据。
en_tdlr: We present the first linear-time randomized algorithms for unbiased approximation of general random walk kernels on sparse graphs, using dependent random walk sampling to generate embeddings without the direct product graph, achieving up to 27x speedup and scalability to massive datasets.
